## Executive Signals
- Chinese lab **DeepSeek** has reportedly raised about **$15 billion** (roughly 100 billion yuan), one of the country's largest funding rounds — two days after Washington ordered federal agencies to remove its technology. Reported — not officially confirmed.
- **OpenAI** is reportedly assembling a round of up to **$30 billion** at a **$1.25 trillion** pre-money valuation, led by Coatue and UAE investors, as it works toward an eventual IPO.
- **Anthropic** opened **Claude Duet**, a proactive agent app that checks your connected apps in the background and asks before it acts, as a US research preview.
- Startup **Recursive** released **Flint**, an Apache-2.0 coding model small enough for a laptop that it says was largely built by its own AI research system.

Sources: [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/demis-hassabis-ai-deepmind-google-isomorphic-2b4e3153) · [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1015277/google-deepminds-demis-hassabis-thinks-agi-is-two-to-three-years-away).

A >$1 trillion round would make OpenAI the most valuable private company ever, and follows a Bloomberg report of a $30 billion round at $1.4 trillion in September. Reported — OpenAI declined to comment. Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/22/openai-funding-round-uae-investors.html) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/22/openai-working-on-new-30b-raise-at-1-25t-valuation-ahead-of-ipo/).
- **2026-10-22 — Global AI-stock selloff:** Renewed doubts about AI spending and rising oil prices sent chip and AI stocks sharply lower; the Nasdaq fell about 2.6%, its steepest daily drop since early June, with AI and chip names accounting for most of the decline. Sources: [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-drop-over-1-ai-worries-resurface-oil-climbs-2026-10-22/) · [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) · [Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-10222026-12187670).

## Editorial Notes
- **Primary window:** every item in the body was first announced or materially updated inside 2026-10-21T05:00:27Z–2026-10-23T05:00:27Z. Paper dates follow Hugging Face Daily Papers for 22–23 October; several were posted to arXiv on 19–20 October but surfaced for the first time in this window.
- **Backfill:** none. The whole 2026-10-14–2026-10-21 recovery range was already inside the primary or recovery windows of the two most recent briefings, and nothing consequential there is missing from them.
- **Reported / unverified:** the DeepSeek and OpenAI funding rounds are reported by Bloomberg and CNBC, not confirmed, and can still change or fall through. Flint's, Carbon-X's, Cohere's, NVIDIA's and Ai2's benchmark, cost and performance figures are the developers' own unless stated otherwise; Carbon-X has not been validated in a wet lab.
- **Unverified listings, excluded:** two model identifiers seen in third-party trackers — OpenAI's "GPT-5.6 Sol Keenable" and Alibaba's "Qwen3.8-Max Internal" — have no vendor page or changelog, so they are not treated as releases.
- **Trimmed under limits (verified, not included):** Anthropic's donation of Agent Skills to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (2026-10-22); Google DeepMind's 10-metre global forest-type map with WRI and IIASA (2026-10-22); Mistral and NVIDIA's industrial-engineering collaboration (2026-10-21); Meta saying its Muse agent passed 10 million users (2026-10-21); NVIDIA and UW's RFD4-Proteina protein-design model (2026-10-21); and OpenAI's tightened partner safety rules and planned SafetyIDs (2026-10-21).
- **Data limits:** GitHub star counts were read on 2026-10-23 UTC and the daily gains are the trending digest's, checked on 2026-10-22 UTC; both move fast. Product Hunt upvotes measure attention, not adoption.
